easyPrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
description:
Activate Boromir by sacrificing it.
When Boromir dies, Yedora triggers, returning Boromir from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Boromir enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Boromir by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Boromir face-up.
Resolve the Boromir ability from step 1.
Repeat.
